verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs explicitly define off-cycle payrolls for corrections/bonuses (gusto-docs-4, gusto-docs-21, gusto-docs-32) with a dedicated guide on creating an off-cycle payroll and specific handling like default withholding/blocked benefits for Bonus reason (gusto-docs-47), plus flexible processing speeds (gusto-docs-3, gusto-docs-15). This is a first-party documented capability with clear API support. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of termination-specific off-cycle payroll flow (e.g., final paycheck handling) and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the off-cycle flow working in practice.
